description: This file defines the DirectoryMembershipService class, which manages and updates the view of cluster membership information for Orleans grains. It handles asynchronous membership updates, maintains the current view, and provides mechanisms for refreshing the view and handling errors.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipService
classes.description: A service that maintains the current view of cluster membership data, processes membership updates asynchronously, and allows refreshing and disposal.

methods.name: RefreshViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the current membership view to at least a specified version, waiting for updates if necessary.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Internal background task that continuously processes membership updates from the ClusterMembershipService.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the service, cancelling ongoing update processing.

methods.name: LogErrorProcessingMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during the processing of membership updates.
